body: The issue can be observed when using [context.vim](https://github.com/wellle/context.vim). The context floating window sets its highlight to `Normal` which used to display in a way that matches an ordinary window, but now takes on `Pmenu` highlighting.
try change `NormalFloat` color see what happen.

@glepnir, here's the result with `NormalFloat` (Neovim 0.8.0 on the left and 0.7.2 on the right).

![normal_float](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/541289/230251294-dd726449-6e06-4e43-a05a-bad09bd4864b.png)
`NormalFloat` link to `Pmenu` in default don't set the winhighlight just change `NormalFloat` background .I think it should work
Hmm, `NormalFloat:Normal` behaves the same as `Normal:Normal` in both cases.

I got this in my plugin before then I do something like this way to change it and it works.

```vim
set termguicolors
let buf = nvim_create_buf(v:false, v:true)
let popup = nvim_open_win(buf, 0, {
      \   'relative':  'editor',
      \   'row':       15,
      \   'col':       5,
      \   'width':     20,
      \   'height':    5,
      \   'focusable': v:true,
      \   'style':     'minimal',
      \   'border':    'single',
      \ })
let ns = nvim_create_namespace('TestWin')
call nvim_win_set_hl_ns(popup, ns)
call nvim_set_hl(ns,'NormalFloat', { 'background': 'red'})
```

@glepnir, in your example the background is set specifically to red. In the scenario where I encountered this issue, the intent is to have the floating window styled like an ordinary window without knowing the actual color, but rather just that `Normal` highlighting is used.

`nvim_get_hl_by_name('Normal', v:true)` returns `{}` for me (using `nvim --clean`). Perhaps this relates to why `call setwinvar(popup, '&winhighlight', 'Normal:Normal')` is not working as expected. `:highlight` reports `Normal` as being cleared.

It appears that the following workaround results in the desired behavior (`Normal` highlighting in the floating window). Thanks for the help @glepnir!

```vim
let ns = nvim_create_namespace('TestWin')
call nvim_win_set_hl_ns(popup, ns)
call nvim_set_hl(ns, 'Normal', {})
```

when create floatwindow there will set the `NormalFloat` id to the float normal attr.  setwinvar  will changed the `w_hl_attr_normal` but it not redraw screen looks like?  IDK then.
